Name: FAR_MODEL_PARAM_ST
Description: Per-map distant view (far model) table. Each Group row names a far model map piece; the rows that follow list the normal map pieces or models it stands in for. Row order is significant: blank fields inherit from the row above.

Fields.Name: Far Part Name
Fields.Description: Name of the far model map piece. If blank, the value from the row above is used.

Fields.Name: Near Part Map: Area
Fields.Description: Area of the map the normal parts belong to (the XX in mXX_YY_ZZ_WW). If -1, the value from the row above is used; on the first row this means the same map as the far part.

Fields.Name: Near Part Map: Block
Fields.Description: Block of the map the normal parts belong to (the YY in mXX_YY_ZZ_WW). If -1, the value from the row above is used; on the first row this means the same map as the far part.

Fields.Name: Near Part Map: Map
Fields.Description: Map index of the map the normal parts belong to (the ZZ in mXX_YY_ZZ_WW). If -1, the value from the row above is used; on the first row this means the same map as the far part.

Fields.Name: Near Part Map: Alt
Fields.Description: Alt index of the map the normal parts belong to (the WW in mXX_YY_ZZ_WW). If -1, the value from the row above is used; on the first row this means the same map as the far part.

Fields.Name: Near Part Entry Type
Fields.Description: What Near Part Name refers to: a group, a part to add, or a part or model to exclude. 'Same as Above' continues the list started by the previous row.

Fields.Name: Near Part Name
Fields.Description: Normal map piece name, group name (for Group rows), or excluded model name, depending on the entry type.
